{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZh6W1mMuWnnYYzkmQrK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VMn42ZaXjUCPLJyLmmewTW","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > cholesky/cholesky.cpp <<'EOF'\n// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky decomposition benchmark.\n//\n// Decomposes a symmetric positive definite matrix A (row-major) into L * L^T\n// with L lower triangular, using a right-looking blocked algorithm with\n// one-step lookahead:\n//\n//   * MPI    : block rows of the matrix are distributed block-cyclically over\n//              the ranks (block row I lives on rank I mod P). Each rank drives\n//              one GPU. Per step only the current panel (one block column of L)\n//              and the factored diagonal block are exchanged, with non-blocking\n//              broadcasts whose chunks are streamed to the GPU as they arrive.\n//   * CUDA   : all O(n^3) work (matrix generation, trailing updates, panel\n//              solves, diagonal block factorisation, validation) runs in\n//              hand-written kernels on the rank's GPU. A high-priority stream\n//              runs the panel path of step k+1 while the bulk trailing update of\n//              step k runs on a second stream.\n//   * OpenMP : host-side gather/reordering, the validation comparison and\n//              reductions.\n//\n// The executable name, command line options and printed output are identical\n// to the original sequential benchmark; only rank 0 prints.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <unistd.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                          \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                          \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                               \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                    \\\n        }                                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define MPI_CHECK(call)                                                            \\\n    do {                                                                           \\\n        int err__ = (call);                                                        \\\n        if (err__ != MPI_SUCCESS) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error %d at %s:%d\\n\", err__, __FILE__, __LINE__); \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                          \\\n        }                                                                          \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// GEMM tile configuration (double precision, register-blocked 4x4 per thread)\nconstexpr int BM = 64;\nconstexpr int BN = 64;\nconstexpr int BK = 16;\nconstexpr int GEMM_THREADS = 256;\nconstexpr int SB = 64;  // sub-block size for diagonal block factorisation / panel solves\n\n// Describes the block-cyclic distribution and the panel layout for the\n// mapped GEMM variants. The exchanged panel of step kb holds, for every rank in\n// rank order, that rank's block rows I > kb in increasing order.\nstruct PanelMap {\n    int nb;       // block size\n    int P;        // number of ranks\n    int rank;     // this rank\n    int nBlocks;  // number of block rows/columns (padded)\n    int kb;       // panel index (block column) of the current step\n    int lstart;   // local block-row index corresponding to C row 0\n    int jbase;    // global block index of column 0 of C\n};\n\n__host__ __device__ inline int panelFirstLocal(const PanelMap& pm, int r) {\n    // first local block row of rank r with global index > kb\n    return (pm.kb + 1 > r) ? (pm.kb + 1 - r + pm.P - 1) / pm.P : 0;\n}\n__host__ __device__ inline int panelTiles(const PanelMap& pm, int r) {\n    const int nl = (pm.nBlocks > r) ? (pm.nBlocks - r + pm.P - 1) / pm.P : 0;\n    const int t = nl - panelFirstLocal(pm, r);\n    return t > 0 ? t : 0;\n}\n__host__ __device__ inline int panelPos(const PanelMap& pm, int I) {\n    // tile index of global block row I inside the exchanged panel\n    const int r = I % pm.P;\n    int off = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < r; ++q) off += panelTiles(pm, q);\n    return off + I / pm.P - panelFirstLocal(pm, r);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// C[M x N] = alpha * A[M x K] * B[N x K]^T + beta * C   (all row-major)\n// Requirements: M, N multiples of 64, K multiple of 16.\n// AMODE 0: A rows are C rows.\n// AMODE 1: A is stored in global block-row order (full matrix); the 64-row tile\n//          at C row row0 (local block row l) is A row I*nb + row0%nb, I = l*P + rank.\n// AMODE 2: A is the exchanged panel; tile row = panelPos(I)*nb + row0%nb.\n// BMAP   : B is the exchanged panel; the tile for global block column J is at\n//          panelPos(J)*nb + col0%nb.\n// LOWER  : tiles with global block column J > global block row I are skipped.\ntemplate <int AMODE, bool BMAP, bool LOWER>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ngemm_nt_kernel(int K, double alpha, const double* __restrict__ A, int lda,\n               const double* __restrict__ B, int ldb, double beta, double* __restrict__ C,\n               int ldc, PanelMap pm) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid & 15;\n    const int ty = tid >> 4;\n    const int row0 = blockIdx.y * BM;\n    const int col0 = blockIdx.x * BN;\n\n    int arow0 = row0;\n    int brow0 = col0;\n    if (AMODE != 0 || BMAP || LOWER) {\n        const int I = (pm.lstart + row0 / pm.nb) * pm.P + pm.rank;\n        const int J = pm.jbase + col0 / pm.nb;\n        if (LOWER && J > I) return;\n        if (AMODE == 1) arow0 = I * pm.nb + (row0 % pm.nb);\n        if (AMODE == 2) arow0 = panelPos(pm, I) * pm.nb + (row0 % pm.nb);\n        if (BMAP) brow0 = panelPos(pm, J) * pm.nb + (col0 % pm.nb);\n    }\n\n    const double* Ab = A + (size_t)arow0 * lda;\n    const double* Bb = B + (size_t)brow0 * ldb;\n\n    __shared__ double As[BK][BM + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[BK][BN + 1];\n\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = 0.0;\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += BK) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < 4; ++q) {\n            const int idx = tid + q * GEMM_THREADS;\n            const int r = idx >> 4;\n            const int c = idx & 15;\n            As[c][r] = Ab[(size_t)r * lda + k0 + c];\n            Bs[c][r] = Bb[(size_t)r * ldb + k0 + c];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < BK; ++kk) {\n            double a[4], b[4];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) a[i] = As[kk][ty * 4 + i];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) b[j] = Bs[kk][tx * 4 + j];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n        double* crow = C + (size_t)(row0 + ty * 4 + i) * ldc + col0 + tx * 4;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n            if (beta == 0.0)\n                crow[j] = alpha * acc[i][j];\n            else\n                crow[j] = alpha * acc[i][j] + beta * crow[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of a 64x64 diagonal sub-block held in shared memory,\n// followed by its explicit lower-triangular inverse. Single thread block of\n// 64 threads (thread i owns row i, later column i of the inverse).\n// On a non-positive pivot the global index (idxBase + j) is recorded in *err\n// (only the first failure is recorded) and the kernel exits.\nconstexpr int POTRF_THREADS = 64;\nconstexpr size_t POTRF_SMEM = 2 * SB * (SB + 1) * sizeof(double);\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(POTRF_THREADS)\npotrf64_kernel(double* __restrict__ T, int ld, double* __restrict__ inv, int* __restrict__ err,\n               int idxBase) {\n    extern __shared__ double smem[];\n    double (*s)[SB + 1] = reinterpret_cast<double (*)[SB + 1]>(smem);\n    double (*w)[SB + 1] = s + SB;\n    __shared__ int bad;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) bad = (*err >= 0) ? 1 : 0;\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < SB * SB; idx += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = idx / SB, m = idx % SB;\n        s[i][m] = T[(size_t)i * ld + m];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (bad) return;  // an earlier sub-block already failed\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < SB; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double d = s[j][j];\n            if (d <= 0.0) {\n                *err = idxBase + j;\n                bad = 1;\n            } else {\n                s[j][j] = sqrt(d);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (bad) return;\n        if (tid > j) s[tid][j] /= s[j][j];\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid > j) {\n            const double lij = s[tid][j];\n            for (int m = j + 1; m <= tid; ++m) s[tid][m] -= lij * s[m][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    // zero the strict upper triangle of the factor\n    for (int m = tid + 1; m < SB; ++m) s[tid][m] = 0.0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // inverse by forward substitution, thread j owns column j\n    {\n        const int j = tid;\n        for (int i = 0; i < j; ++i) w[i][j] = 0.0;\n        for (int i = j; i < SB; ++i) {\n            double v = (i == j) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n            for (int m = j; m < i; ++m) v -= s[i][m] * w[m][j];\n            w[i][j] = v / s[i][i];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < SB * SB; idx += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = idx / SB, m = idx % SB;\n        T[(size_t)i * ld + m] = s[i][m];\n        inv[i * SB + m] = w[i][m];\n    }\n}\n\n// A_local[i][i] += n for real rows, = 1 for padding rows (identity padding\n// leaves the Cholesky factor of the real part unchanged).\n__global__ void fix_diagonal_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, int ldA, int rowsLocal, int nb, int P,\n                                    int rank, long n) {\n    const int lr = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (lr >= rowsLocal) return;\n    const long gi = (long)((lr / nb) * P + rank) * nb + (lr % nb);\n    double* d = A + (size_t)lr * ldA + gi;\n    if (gi < n)\n        *d += (double)n;\n    else\n        *d = 1.0;\n}\n\n// Zero the strict upper triangle of the local rows.\n__global__ void zero_upper_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, int ldA, int rowsLocal, int cols,\n                                  int nb, int P, int rank) {\n    const int c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int lr = blockIdx.y;\n    if (lr >= rowsLocal || c >= cols) return;\n    const long gi = (long)((lr / nb) * P + rank) * nb + (lr % nb);\n    if (c > gi) A[(size_t)lr * ldA + c] = 0.0;\n}\n\n// Set unit diagonal for padding rows of a full (Npad x Npad) matrix.\n__global__ void pad_identity_kernel(double* __restrict__ M, int ld, long n, int Npad) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= Npad || i < n) return;\n    M[(size_t)i * ld + i] = 1.0;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Dist {\n    int rank = 0, P = 1;\n    size_t n = 0;              // real matrix size\n    int nb = 256;              // block size\n    int Npad = 0;              // padded size (multiple of nb)\n    int nBlocks = 0;           // Npad / nb\n    int nLocal = 0;            // local block rows\n    int rowsLocal = 0;         // nLocal * nb\n    size_t realRowsLocal = 0;  // local rows that are < n\n    std::vector<size_t> realRowOff;  // host offset (in rows) of each local block row\n    std::vector<int> realRowCnt;     // real rows of each local block row\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;   // bulk trailing-update stream\n    cudaStream_t pstream = nullptr;  // high-priority panel (lookahead) stream\n    MPI_Datatype rowType = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL;  // n contiguous doubles\n\n    int globalBlock(int l) const { return l * P + rank; }\n    int ownerOf(int I) const { return I % P; }\n    int localOf(int I) const { return I / P; }\n};\n\nstatic int chooseBlockSize(size_t n) {\n    if (n <= 1024) return 64;\n    if (n <= 4096) return 128;\n    return 256;\n}\n\nstatic void setupDist(Dist& d, size_t n) {\n    d.n = n;\n    d.nb = chooseBlockSize(n);\n    d.nBlocks = (int)((n + d.nb - 1) / d.nb);\n    d.Npad = d.nBlocks * d.nb;\n    d.nLocal = (d.nBlocks > d.rank) ? (d.nBlocks - d.rank + d.P - 1) / d.P : 0;\n    d.rowsLocal = d.nLocal * d.nb;\n    d.realRowOff.assign(d.nLocal + 1, 0);\n    d.realRowCnt.assign(d.nLocal, 0);\n    size_t off = 0;\n    for (int l = 0; l < d.nLocal; ++l) {\n        const long first = (long)d.globalBlock(l) * d.nb;\n        long cnt = std::min<long>(d.nb, (long)n - first);\n        if (cnt < 0) cnt = 0;\n        d.realRowOff[l] = off;\n        d.realRowCnt[l] = (int)cnt;\n        off += cnt;\n    }\n    d.realRowOff[d.nLocal] = off;\n    d.realRowsLocal = off;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_contiguous((int)n, MPI_DOUBLE, &d.rowType));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_commit(&d.rowType));\n}\n\n// GEMM launch helper ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ntemplate <int AMODE, bool BMAP, bool LOWER>\nstatic void gemm_nt(cudaStream_t st, int M, int N, int K, double alpha, const double* A, int lda,\n                    const double* B, int ldb, double beta, double* C, int ldc, const PanelMap& pm) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid(N / BN, M / BM);\n    gemm_nt_kernel<AMODE, BMAP, LOWER><<<grid, GEMM_THREADS, 0, st>>>(K, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb,\n                                                                        beta, C, ldc, pm);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nstatic PanelMap plainMap(const Dist& d) { return PanelMap{d.nb, d.P, d.rank, d.nBlocks, 0, 0, 0}; }\n\n// Copy the local (real) rows of a device matrix (ld = Npad) to a host buffer\n// with leading dimension n, in local block-row order.\nstatic void localRowsToHost(const Dist& d, const double* dM, double* hM) {\n    for (int l = 0; l < d.nLocal; ++l) {\n        if (d.realRowCnt[l] == 0) continue;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hM + d.realRowOff[l] * d.n, d.n * sizeof(double),\n                                     dM + (size_t)l * d.nb * d.Npad, (size_t)d.Npad * sizeof(double),\n                                     d.n * sizeof(double), d.realRowCnt[l], cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,\n                                     d.stream));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.stream));\n}\n\n// Gather the local real rows of all ranks (local block-row order per rank) onto\n// rank 0 and reorder into a full n x n matrix.\nstatic void gatherToRoot(const Dist& d, const double* hLocal, std::vector<double>& full) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(d.P), displs(d.P);\n    const int myCount = (int)d.realRowsLocal;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(&myCount, 1, MPI_INT, counts.data(), 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    std::vector<double> packed;\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        size_t total = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < d.P; ++r) {\n            displs[r] = (int)total;\n            total += counts[r];\n        }\n        packed.resize(total * d.n);\n    }\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(hLocal, myCount, d.rowType, packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(),\n                          d.rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        full.resize(d.n * d.n);\n        // rank r's chunk holds its block rows in order: block t of rank r is global block t*P + r\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n        for (int I = 0; I < d.nBlocks; ++I) {\n            const int r = I % d.P;\n            const int t = I / d.P;\n            size_t off = 0;  // row offset of block t within rank r's chunk\n            for (int tt = 0; tt < t; ++tt) {\n                const long first = (long)(tt * d.P + r) * d.nb;\n                long cnt = std::min<long>(d.nb, (long)d.n - first);\n                if (cnt < 0) cnt = 0;\n                off += cnt;\n            }\n            const long first = (long)I * d.nb;\n            long cnt = std::min<long>(d.nb, (long)d.n - first);\n            if (cnt <= 0) continue;\n            std::memcpy(full.data() + (size_t)first * d.n,\n                        packed.data() + ((size_t)displs[r] + off) * d.n,\n                        (size_t)cnt * d.n * sizeof(double));\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Matrix generation (same random sequence as the original: rand_r, seed 42)\n// A = B * B^T + n * I, computed on the GPU for the local block rows.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(const Dist& d, double* dA) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    // Random matrix B (identical on every rank; the rand_r sequence is inherently sequential)\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, (size_t)d.Npad * d.Npad * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(dB, 0, (size_t)d.Npad * d.Npad * sizeof(double), d.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dB, (size_t)d.Npad * sizeof(double), B.data(), n * sizeof(double),\n                                 n * sizeof(double), n, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, d.stream));\n\n    // A_local = B_local * B^T  (A operand mapped to the global block rows of B)\n    gemm_nt<1, false, false>(d.stream, d.rowsLocal, d.Npad, d.Npad, 1.0, dB, d.Npad, dB, d.Npad,\n                             0.0, dA, d.Npad, plainMap(d));\n\n    if (d.rowsLocal > 0) {\n        fix_diagonal_kernel<<<(d.rowsLocal + 255) / 256, 256, 0, d.stream>>>(\n            dA, d.Npad, d.rowsLocal, d.nb, d.P, d.rank, (long)n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed blocked Cholesky\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Workspace {\n    double* dPanel[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};  // exchanged panel (rank-concatenated tile order),\n                                             // double buffered for the lookahead\n    double* dPanelLoc = nullptr;             // (rowsLocal x nb) local panel tiles\n    double* dLkk = nullptr;                  // nb x nb factored diagonal block (non-owners)\n    double* dInv64 = nullptr;                // (nb/64) inverses of the 64x64 diagonal sub-blocks\n    double* dTmp = nullptr;                  // max(rowsLocal, nb) x 64 scratch for solves\n    int* dErr = nullptr;\n    double* hPanelLoc = nullptr;  // pinned: local panel tiles\n    double* hPanelAll = nullptr;  // pinned: panel tiles of all ranks\n    double* hDiag = nullptr;      // pinned: [L_kk | inverses of its sub-blocks]\n    cudaEvent_t evPanelReady[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    cudaEvent_t evUpdateDone[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n};\n\nstatic bool choleskyDecomposition(const Dist& d, double* dA, Workspace& w, int& failIndex) {\n    const int nb = d.nb;\n    const int P = d.P;\n    const size_t tile = (size_t)nb * nb;\n    const int nsb = nb / SB;\n    const size_t invBytes = (size_t)nsb * SB * SB * sizeof(double);\n    cudaStream_t ps = d.pstream;  // panel path (lookahead), high priority\n    cudaStream_t us = d.stream;   // bulk trailing updates\n    const PanelMap plain = plainMap(d);\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs(P);\n    failIndex = -1;\n\n    auto mapFor = [&](int kb, int jbase) {\n        PanelMap pm{nb, P, d.rank, d.nBlocks, kb, panelFirstLocal(PanelMap{nb, P, d.rank, d.nBlocks, kb, 0, 0}, d.rank), jbase};\n        return pm;\n    };\n\n    // Factorise diagonal block kb in place (owner only) and produce the inverses\n    // of its 64x64 diagonal sub-blocks. Returns the failing global index or -1.\n    auto factorDiagonal = [&](int kb) -> int {\n        double* T = dA + (size_t)d.localOf(kb) * nb * d.Npad + (size_t)kb * nb;\n        int err = -1;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(w.dErr, 0xFF, sizeof(int), ps));  // -1\n        for (int c = 0; c < nsb; ++c) {\n            double* Tc = T + (size_t)c * SB * d.Npad + (size_t)c * SB;\n            double* invc = w.dInv64 + (size_t)c * SB * SB;\n            potrf64_kernel<<<1, POTRF_THREADS, POTRF_SMEM, ps>>>(Tc, d.Npad, invc, w.dErr,\n                                                                 kb * nb + c * SB);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            const int R = (nsb - 1 - c) * SB;\n            if (R > 0) {\n                double* below = T + (size_t)(c + 1) * SB * d.Npad + (size_t)c * SB;\n                // L_below = A_below * L_cc^{-T}\n                gemm_nt<0, false, false>(ps, R, SB, SB, 1.0, below, d.Npad, invc, SB, 0.0, w.dTmp,\n                                         SB, plain);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(below, (size_t)d.Npad * sizeof(double), w.dTmp,\n                                             SB * sizeof(double), SB * sizeof(double), R,\n                                             cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, ps));\n                // trailing sub-matrix of the block\n                double* trail = T + (size_t)(c + 1) * SB * d.Npad + (size_t)(c + 1) * SB;\n                gemm_nt<0, false, false>(ps, R, R, SB, -1.0, below, d.Npad, below, d.Npad, 1.0,\n                                         trail, d.Npad, plain);\n            }\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&err, w.dErr, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, ps));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(w.hDiag, nb * sizeof(double), T, (size_t)d.Npad * sizeof(double),\n                                     nb * sizeof(double), nb, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, ps));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(w.hDiag + tile, w.dInv64, invBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, ps));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ps));\n        return err;\n    };\n\n    // Panel step for block column kb: factorise the diagonal block, broadcast it,\n    // solve the local panel tiles, exchange the panel between all ranks and\n    // upload it into dPanel[kb % 2]. Returns false if not positive definite.\n    auto panelStep = [&](int kb) -> bool {\n        const int owner = d.ownerOf(kb);\n        int err = -1;\n        if (d.rank == owner) err = factorDiagonal(kb);\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&err, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        if (err >= 0) {\n            failIndex = err;\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (kb + 1 >= d.nBlocks) return true;  // last block: nothing below\n\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(w.hDiag, (int)(tile + (size_t)nsb * SB * SB), MPI_DOUBLE, owner,\n                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        const double* Lkk;\n        int ldL;\n        if (d.rank == owner) {\n            Lkk = dA + (size_t)d.localOf(kb) * nb * d.Npad + (size_t)kb * nb;\n            ldL = d.Npad;\n        } else {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(w.dLkk, w.hDiag, tile * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, ps));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(w.dInv64, w.hDiag + tile, invBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,\n                                       ps));\n            Lkk = w.dLkk;\n            ldL = nb;\n        }\n\n        // Panel solve X = A_Ik * L_kk^{-T} for the local block rows I > kb, blocked\n        // over 64-column chunks: X_c = (A_c - X_{<c} * L_{c,<c}^T) * L_cc^{-T}.\n        const PanelMap pm = mapFor(kb, kb + 1);\n        const int lstart = pm.lstart;\n        const int Mloc = panelTiles(pm, d.rank) * nb;\n        const int myDispl = panelPos(pm, kb + 1 <= d.rank ? d.rank : ((lstart * P) + d.rank)) * (int)tile;\n        if (Mloc > 0) {\n            const double* Acol = dA + (size_t)lstart * nb * d.Npad + (size_t)kb * nb;\n            for (int c = 0; c < nsb; ++c) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(w.dTmp, SB * sizeof(double), Acol + c * SB,\n                                             (size_t)d.Npad * sizeof(double), SB * sizeof(double),\n                                             Mloc, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, ps));\n                if (c > 0) {\n                    gemm_nt<0, false, false>(ps, Mloc, SB, c * SB, -1.0, w.dPanelLoc, nb,\n                                             Lkk + (size_t)c * SB * ldL, ldL, 1.0, w.dTmp, SB, plain);\n                }\n                gemm_nt<0, false, false>(ps, Mloc, SB, SB, 1.0, w.dTmp, SB,\n                                         w.dInv64 + (size_t)c * SB * SB, SB, 0.0,\n                                         w.dPanelLoc + c * SB, nb, plain);\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(w.hPanelLoc, w.dPanelLoc, (size_t)Mloc * nb * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, ps));\n            // final L tiles back into the local matrix, and into our slot of the panel\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dA + (size_t)lstart * nb * d.Npad + (size_t)kb * nb,\n                                         (size_t)d.Npad * sizeof(double), w.dPanelLoc,\n                                         nb * sizeof(double), nb * sizeof(double), Mloc,\n                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, ps));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(w.dPanel[kb % 2] + myDispl, w.dPanelLoc,\n                                       (size_t)Mloc * nb * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice,\n                                       ps));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ps));\n        }\n\n        // Exchange the panel: every rank broadcasts its tiles; chunks are uploaded\n        // to the GPU as they arrive.\n        int total = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = (int)(panelTiles(pm, r) * tile);\n            displs[r] = total;\n            total += counts[r];\n        }\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            reqs[r] = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n            if (counts[r] == 0) continue;\n            double* buf = (r == d.rank) ? w.hPanelLoc : w.hPanelAll + displs[r];\n            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Ibcast(buf, counts[r], MPI_DOUBLE, r, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[r]));\n        }\n        for (;;) {\n            int idx = MPI_UNDEFINED;\n            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitany(P, reqs.data(), &idx, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE));\n            if (idx == MPI_UNDEFINED) break;\n            if (idx == d.rank) continue;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(w.dPanel[kb % 2] + displs[idx], w.hPanelAll + displs[idx],\n                                       (size_t)counts[idx] * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,\n                                       ps));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(w.evPanelReady[kb % 2], ps));\n        return true;\n    };\n\n    // Trailing update with panel kb for the local rows I > kb and block columns\n    // jfirst <= J <= I (jcount block columns), on stream st.\n    auto trailingUpdate = [&](cudaStream_t st, int kb, int jfirst, int jcount) {\n        const PanelMap pm = Single thread block of\n// 256 threads: 4 threads per row for the rank-1 updates, 4 threads per column\n// for the inverse. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZiyiNTDkoeZ2MuFgHPR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014fhXGX6NowYjZjpzfRgvnf","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > cholesky/cholesky.cpp <<'EOF'\n// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky decomposition benchmark.\n//\n// Decomposes a symmetric positive definite matrix A (row-major) into L * L^T\n// with L lower triangular, using a right-looking blocked algorithm with\n// two-step lookahead:\n//\n//   * MPI    : block rows of the matrix are distributed block-cyclically over\n//              the ranks (block row I lives on rank I mod P). Each rank drives\n//              one GPU. Per step only the current panel (one block column of L)\n//              and the factored diagonal block are exchanged. Ranks on the same\n//              node exchange through an MPI shared-memory window that the GPUs\n//              read and write directly; across nodes each chunk is sent once to\n//              the node leader.\n//   * CUDA   : all O(n^3) work (matrix generation, trailing updates, panel\n//              solves, diagonal block factorisation, validation) runs in\n//              hand-written kernels on the rank's GPU. A high-priority stream\n//              runs the panel path of step k+1 while the bulk trailing update of\n//              step k runs on a second stream; uploads use a third stream.\n//   * OpenMP : host-side gather/reordering, the validation comparison and\n//              reductions.\n//\n// The executable name, command line options and printed output are identical\n// to the original sequential benchmark; only rank 0 prints.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <dirent.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <sched.h>\n#include <unistd.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                          \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                          \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                               \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                    \\\n        }                                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define MPI_CHECK(call)                                                            \\\n    do {                                                                           \\\n        int err__ = (call);                                                        \\\n        if (err__ != MPI_SUCCESS) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error %d at %s:%d\\n\", err__, __FILE__, __LINE__); \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                          \\\n        }                                                                          \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// GEMM tile configuration (double precision). 256 threads compute a\n// (16*TM) x 64 tile with TM x 4 outputs per thread; TM = 4 for large GEMMs,\n// TM = 1 for narrow ones (more thread blocks, better SM utilisation).\nconstexpr int BN = 64;\nconstexpr int BK = 16;\nconstexpr int GEMM_THREADS = 256;\nconstexpr int SB = 64;        // sub-block size for diagonal block factorisation / panel solves\nconstexpr int LOOKAHEAD = 2;  // block columns updated ahead of the bulk trailing update\n\n// Describes the block-cyclic distribution and the panel layout for the\n// mapped GEMM variants. The exchanged panel of step kb holds, for every rank in\n// rank order, that rank's block rows I > kb in increasing order.\nstruct PanelMap {\n    int nb;       // block size\n    int P;        // number of ranks\n    int rank;     // this rank\n    int nBlocks;  // number of block rows/columns (padded)\n    int kb;       // panel index (block column) of the current step\n    int lstart;   // local block-row index corresponding to C row 0\n    int jbase;    // global block index of column 0 of C\n};\n\n__host__ __device__ inline int panelFirstLocal(const PanelMap& pm, int r) {\n    // first local block row of rank r with global index > kb\n    return (pm.kb + 1 > r) ? (pm.kb + 1 - r + pm.P - 1) / pm.P : 0;\n}\n__host__ __device__ inline int panelTiles(const PanelMap& pm, int r) {\n    const int nl = (pm.nBlocks > r) ? (pm.nBlocks - r + pm.P - 1) / pm.P : 0;\n    const int t = nl - panelFirstLocal(pm, r);\n    return t > 0 ? t : 0;\n}\n__host__ __device__ inline int panelPos(const PanelMap& pm, int I) {\n    // tile index of global block row I inside the exchanged panel\n    const int r = I % pm.P;\n    int off = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < r; ++q) off += panelTiles(pm, q);\n    return off + I / pm.P - panelFirstLocal(pm, r);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// C[M x N] = alpha * A[M x K] * B[N x K]^T + beta * C   (all row-major)\n// Requirements: M multiple of 16*TM, N multiple of 64, K multiple of 16.\n// AMODE 0: A rows are C rows.\n// AMODE 1: A is stored in global block-row order (full matrix); the tile at\n//          C row row0 (local block row l) is A row I*nb + row0%nb, I = l*P + rank.\n// AMODE 2: A is the exchanged panel; tile row = panelPos(I)*nb + row0%nb.\n// BMAP   : B is the exchanged panel; the tile for global block column J is at\n//          panelPos(J)*nb + col0%nb.\n// LOWER  : tiles with global block column J > global block row I are skipped.\ntemplate <int TM, int AMODE, bool BMAP, bool LOWER>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ngemm_nt_kernel(int K, double alpha, const double* __restrict__ A, int lda,\n               const double* __restrict__ B, int ldb, double beta, double* __restrict__ C,\n               int ldc, PanelMap pm) {\n    constexpr int BM = 16 * TM;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid & 15;\n    const int ty = tid >> 4;\n    const int row0 = blockIdx.y * BM;\n    const int col0 = blockIdx.x * BN;\n\n    int arow0 = row0;\n    int brow0 = col0;\n    if (AMODE != 0 || BMAP || LOWER) {\n        const int I = (pm.lstart + row0 / pm.nb) * pm.P + pm.rank;\n        const int J = pm.jbase + col0 / pm.nb;\n        if (LOWER && J > I) return;\n        if (AMODE == 1) arow0 = I * pm.nb + (row0 % pm.nb);\n        if (AMODE == 2) arow0 = panelPos(pm, I) * pm.nb + (row0 % pm.nb);\n        if (BMAP) brow0 = panelPos(pm, J) * pm.nb + (col0 % pm.nb);\n    }\n\n    const double* Ab = A + (size_t)arow0 * lda;\n    const double* Bb = B + (size_t)brow0 * ldb;\n\n    __shared__ double As[BK][BM + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[BK][BN + 1];\n\n    double acc[TM][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = 0.0;\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += BK) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < TM; ++q) {\n            const int idx = tid + q * GEMM_THREADS;\n            As[idx & 15][idx >> 4] = Ab[(size_t)(idx >> 4) * lda + k0 + (idx & 15)];\n        }\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < 4; ++q) {\n            const int idx = tid + q * GEMM_THREADS;\n            Bs[idx & 15][idx >> 4] = Bb[(size_t)(idx >> 4) * ldb + k0 + (idx & 15)];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < BK; ++kk) {\n            double a[TM], b[4];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) a[i] = As[kk][ty * TM + i];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) b[j] = Bs[kk][tx * 4 + j];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) {\n        double* crow = C + (size_t)(row0 + ty * TM + i) * ldc + col0 + tx * 4;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n            if (beta == 0.0)\n                crow[j] = alpha * acc[i][j];\n            else\n                crow[j] = alpha * acc[i][j] + beta * crow[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of a 64x64 diagonal sub-block held in shared memory,\n// followed by its explicit lower-triangular inverse. Single thread block of\n// 256 threads: 4 threads per row for the rank-1 updates, 4 threads per column\n// for the inverse. On a non-positive pivot the global index (idxBase + j) is\n// recorded in *err (only the first failure is recorded) and the kernel exits.\nconstexpr int POTRF_THREADS = 256;\nconstexpr size_t POTRF_SMEM = 2 * SB * (SB + 1) * sizeof(double);\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(POTRF_THREADS)\npotrf64_kernel(double* __restrict__ T, int ld, double* __restrict__ inv, int* __restrict__ err,\n               int idxBase) {\n    extern __shared__ double smem[];\n    double (*s)[SB + 1] = reinterpret_cast<double (*)[SB + 1]>(smem);\n    double (*w)[SB + 1] = s + SB;\n    __shared__ int bad;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int i = tid >> 2;  // row (or column for the inverse)\n    const int q = tid & 3;   // lane within the group of 4\n\n    if (tid == 0) bad = (*err >= 0) ? 1 : 0;\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < SB * SB; idx += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int r = idx / SB, m = idx % SB;\n        s[r][m] = T[(size_t)r * ld + m];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (bad) return;  // an earlier sub-block already failed\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < SB; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double d = s[j][j];\n            if (d <= 0.0) {\n                *err = idxBase + j;\n                bad = 1;\n            } else {\n                s[j][j] = sqrt(d);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (bad) return;\n        if (i > j && q == 0) s[i][j] /= s[j][j];\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (i > j) {\n            const double lij = s[i][j];\n            for (int m = j + 1 + q; m <= i; m += 4) s[i][m] -= lij * s[m][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    // zero the strict upper triangle of the factor\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < SB * SB; idx += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int r = idx / SB, m = idx % SB;\n        if (m > r) s[r][m] = 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // inverse by forward substitution: the 4 threads of column j = i split each\n    // inner product and combine it with warp shuffles (uniform loop over r for\n    // the whole warp, as the shuffles need all lanes)\n    {\n        const int j = i;\n        for (int r = 0; r < SB; ++r) {\n            double v = 0.0;\n            if (r >= j)\n                for (int m = j + q; m < r; m += 4) v += s[r][m] * w[m][j];\n            v += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, 1);\n            v += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, 2);\n            if (q == 0) w[r][j] = (r < j) ? 0.0 : (((r == j) ? 1.0 : 0.0) - v) / s[r][r];\n            __syncwarp();\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < SB * SB; idx += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int r = idx / SB, m = idx % SB;\n        T[(size_t)r * ld + m] = s[r][m];\n        inv[r * SB + m] = w[r][m];\n    }\n}\n\n// A_local[i][i] += n for real rows, = 1 for padding rows (identity padding\n// leaves the Cholesky factor of the real part unchanged).\n__global__ void fix_diagonal_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, int ldA, int rowsLocal, int nb, int P,\n                                    int rank, long n) {\n    const int lr = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (lr >= rowsLocal) return;\n    const long gi = (long)((lr / nb) * P + rank) * nb + (lr % nb);\n    double* d = A + (size_t)lr * ldA + gi;\n    if (gi < n)\n        *d += (double)n;\n    else\n        *d = 1.0;\n}\n\n// Zero the strict upper triangle of the local rows.\n__global__ void zero_upper_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, int ldA, int rowsLocal, int cols,\n                                  int nb, int P, int rank) {\n    const int c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int lr = blockIdx.y;\n    if (lr >= rowsLocal || c >= cols) return;\n    const long gi = (long)((lr / nb) * P + rank) * nb + (lr % nb);\n    if (c > gi) A[(size_t)lr * ldA + c] = 0.0;\n}\n\n// Set unit diagonal for padding rows of a full (Npad x Npad) matrix.\n__global__ void pad_identity_kernel(double* __restrict__ M, int ld, long n, int Npad) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= Npad || i < n) return;\n    M[(size_t)i * ld + i] = 1.0;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Dist {\n    int rank = 0, P = 1;\n    size_t n = 0;              // real matrix size\n    int nb = 256;              // block size\n    int Npad = 0;              // padded size (multiple of nb)\n    int nBlocks = 0;           // Npad / nb\n    int nLocal = 0;            // local block rows\n    int rowsLocal = 0;         // nLocal * nb\n    size_t realRowsLocal = 0;  // local rows that are < n\n    std::vector<size_t> realRowOff;  // host offset (in rows) of each local block row\n    std::vector<int> realRowCnt;     // real rows of each local block row\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;   // bulk trailing-update stream\n    cudaStream_t pstream = nullptr;  // high-priority panel (lookahead) stream\n    cudaStream_t cstream = nullptr;  // panel upload stream\n    MPI_Datatype rowType = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL;  // n contiguous doubles\n\n    // node topology\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;\n    int nodeRank = 0, nodeSize = 1;\n    std::vector<int> nodeOf;    // node id (world rank of the node leader) per world rank\n    std::vector<int> leaders;   // world ranks of all node leaders\n    int myNode = 0;\n\n    int globalBlock(int l) const { return l * P + rank; }\n    int ownerOf(int I) const { return I % P; }\n    int localOf(int I) const { return I / P; }\n};\n\nstatic int chooseBlockSize(size_t n) {\n    if (n <= 1024) return 64;\n    if (n <= 4096) return 128;\n    return 256;\n}\n\nstatic void setupDist(Dist& d, size_t n) {\n    d.n = n;\n    d.nb = chooseBlockSize(n);\n    d.nBlocks = (int)((n + d.nb - 1) / d.nb);\n    d.Npad = d.nBlocks * d.nb;\n    d.nLocal = (d.nBlocks > d.rank) ? (d.nBlocks - d.rank + d.P - 1) / d.P : 0;\n    d.rowsLocal = d.nLocal * d.nb;\n    d.realRowOff.assign(d.nLocal + 1, 0);\n    d.realRowCnt.assign(d.nLocal, 0);\n    size_t off = 0;\n    for (int l = 0; l < d.nLocal; ++l) {\n        const long first = (long)d.globalBlock(l) * d.nb;\n        long cnt = std::min<long>(d.nb, (long)n - first);\n        if (cnt < 0) cnt = 0;\n        d.realRowOff[l] = off;\n        d.realRowCnt[l] = (int)cnt;\n        off += cnt;\n    }\n    d.realRowOff[d.nLocal] = off;\n    d.realRowsLocal = off;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_contiguous((int)n, MPI_DOUBLE, &d.rowType));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_commit(&d.rowType));\n}\n\n// Node topology: ranks sharing memory form a node; the node leader is the\n// lowest world rank on it.\nstatic void setupTopology(Dist& d) {\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0, MPI_INFO_NULL,\n                                  &d.nodeComm));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(d.nodeComm, &d.nodeRank));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(d.nodeComm, &d.nodeSize));\n    int leader = d.rank;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&leader, 1, MPI_INT, 0, d.nodeComm));\n    d.myNode = leader;\n    d.nodeOf.assign(d.P, 0);\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgather(&leader, 1, MPI_INT, d.nodeOf.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    for (int r = 0; r < d.P; ++r)\n        if (d.nodeOf[r] == r) d.leaders.push_back(r);\n}\n\n// NUMA node of the CPU this thread currently runs on (-1 if unknown)\nstatic int currentNumaNode() {\n    const int cpu = sched_getcpu();\n    if (cpu < 0) return -1;\n    char path[128];\n    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d\", cpu);\n    DIR* dir = opendir(path);\n    if (!dir) return -1;\n    int node = -1;\n    while (dirent* e = readdir(dir)) {\n        if (strncmp(e->d_name, \"node\", 4) == 0 && e->d_name[4] >= '0' && e->d_name[4] <= '9') {\n            node = atoi(e->d_name + 4);\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    closedir(dir);\n    return node;\n}\n\n// NUMA node of a CUDA device (-1 if unknown)\nstatic int deviceNumaNode(int dev) {\n    char bus[64];\n    if (cudaDeviceGetPCIBusId(bus, sizeof(bus), dev) != cudaSuccess) return -1;\n    for (char* p = bus; *p; ++p) *p = (char)tolower(*p);\n    char path[160];\n    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/bus/pci/devices/%s/numa_node\", bus);\n    FILE* f = fopen(path, \"r\");\n    if (!f) return -1;\n    int node = -1;\n    if (fscanf(f, \"%d\", &node) != 1) node = -1;\n    fclose(f);\n    return node;\n}\n\n// Pick one GPU per rank on the node, preferring GPUs attached to the rank's\n// NUMA node. All ranks on the node compute the same assignment.\nstatic int selectDevice(const Dist& d) {\n    int devCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount));\n    if (devCount <= 0) {\n        if (d.rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices found\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    std::vector<int> devNuma(devCount);\n    for (int i = 0; i < devCount; ++i) devNuma[i] = deviceNumaNode(i);\n    const int myNuma = currentNumaNode();\n    std::vector<int> prefs(d.nodeSize);\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgather(&myNuma, 1, MPI_INT, prefs.data(), 1, MPI_INT, d.nodeComm));\n    std::vector<int> assigned(d.nodeSize, -1);\n    std::vector<int> used(devCount, 0);\n    for (int r = 0; r < d.nodeSize; ++r) {\n        if (r % devCount == 0) std::fill(used.begin(), used.end(), 0);  // wrap around\n        int pick = -1;\n        for (int i = 0; i < devCount && pick < 0; ++i)\n            if (!used[i] && prefs[r] >= 0 && devNuma[i] == prefs[r]) pick = i;\n        for (int i = 0; i < devCount && pick < 0; ++i)\n            if (!used[i]) pick = i;\n        used[pick] = 1;\n        assigned[r] = pick;\n    }\n    return assigned[d.nodeRank];\n}\n\n// GEMM launch helper ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ntemplate <int TM, int AMODE, bool BMAP, bool LOWER>\nstatic void gemm_nt(cudaStream_t st, int M, int N, int K, double alpha, const double* A, int lda,\n                    const double* B, int ldb, double beta, double* C, int ldc, const PanelMap& pm) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0)             d.stream));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.stream));\n}\n\n// Gather the local real rows of all ranks (local block-row order per rank) onto\n// rank 0 and reorder into a (int)d.realRowsLocal;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(&myCount, 1, MPI_INT, counts.data(), 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    std::vector<double> packed;\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        size_t total = * sizeof(double), SB * sizeof(double), R,\n                                             cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, ps));\n                // trailing sub-matrix of the block\n                double* {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZjsYBjYAPstUVrfitjg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WJwKQRUB65WDpbNN73UWK3","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/.claude/projects/-home-llmtest-evals-20261011-092100-cholesky-claude-fable-5-1-cc-medium-hybrid-r4/memory/accelerator-node-characteristics.md","content":"---\nname: accelerator-node-characteristics\ndescription: Measured hardware/software traits of this benchmark node (4x RTX 3090, no GPU peer access, slow MPI shared-memory transport, OpenMP pool pitfalls) that shape hybrid MPI+OpenMP+CUDA designs\nmetadata:\n  type: project\n---\n\nNode used for the cholesky hybrid work (measured 2026-10-31): 2x AMD EPYC 7763 (256 logical CPUs, 2 NUMA nodes),\n4x GeForce RTX 3090 (sm_86, FP64 peak only ~0.55 TFLOPS per GPU), CUDA 12.0, Open MPI 4.1.6 without CUDA support,\ngcc 13 (nvcc accepts it without flags), CMake 3.30. GPUs 0,1 sit on NUMA node 0 and GPUs 2,3 on NUMA node 1.\n\n- cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer is 0 for every GPU pair, so GPU-to-GPU data must go through host memory.\n- Open MPI shared-memory transport only delivers ~2.4 GB/s per receiver for multi-MB messages (CMA likely blocked by the bwrap sandbox); an MPI_Win_allocate_shared window that the GPUs DMA into/out of directly (cudaHostRegister works on it) is several times faster.\n- Pinned H2D/D2H bandwidth is ~12 GB/s; single-thread-block FP64 kernels are bounded by 2 FMA/clk/SM, so tiny factorisation kernels must spread over many blocks.\n- Default OpenMP pool (256 threads per rank) costs ~50 ms of thread start-up plus milliseconds per parallel region and starves the MPI/CUDA launch thread when several ranks share the node; capping at ~16 threads per rank fixed it.\n\n**Why:** these facts are not visible from the code and cost most of the tuning time to discover.\n**How to apply:** when parallelising other benchmarks here, keep intra-node exchange in a shared window, assume no P2P, keep OpenMP pools small per rank, and expect FP64 GPU peaks far below the CPU's.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1568,"cache_read_input_tokens":197406,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1568},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ca2a234b-5dac-43c0-9e64-f3761aa0be98","uuid":"f1672c9b-2a10-4fd8-8aa6-86295b8f75dd","timestamp":"2026-10-31T05:11:20.654Z","request_id":"req_011CgZjsXpQcyJndxEUGrCtT"}

GPUs 0,1 sit on NUMA node 0 and GPUs 2,3 on NUMA node 1.\n\n- cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer is 0 for every GPU pair, so GPU-to-GPU data must go through host memory.\n- Open MPI shared-memory transport only delivers ~2.4 GB/s per receiver for multi-MB messages (CMA likely blocked by the bwrap sandbox); an MPI_Win_allocate_shared window that the GPUs DMA into/out of directly (cudaHostRegister works on it) is several times faster.\n- Pinned H2D/D2H bandwidth is ~12 GB/s; single-thread-block FP64 kernels are bounded by 2 FMA/clk/SM, so tiny factorisation kernels must spread over many blocks.\n- Default OpenMP pool (256 threads per rank) costs ~50 ms of thread start-up plus milliseconds per parallel region and starves the MPI/CUDA launch thread when several ranks share the node; capping at ~16 threads per rank fixed it.\n\n**Why:** these facts are not visible from the code and cost most of the tuning time to discover.\n**How to apply:** when parallelising other benchmarks here, keep intra-node exchange in a shared window, assume no P2P, keep OpenMP pools small per rank, and expect FP64 GPU peaks far below the CPU's.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false,"memdirStamped":true}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZjtn5Ay9wSDfcXY3Cr2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid parallelization is complete and verified. Only `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `cholesky`, and no new files or dependencies were added.\n\n**Design**\n\n- **MPI**: block rows are distributed block-cyclically; each rank drives one GPU, chosen by NUMA affinity. Per step only the panel and the factored diagonal block move. Ranks on a node exchange through an MPI shared-memory window that the GPUs read and write directly by DMA, because the MPI copy path here only reaches about 2.4 GB/s. Across nodes each chunk is sent once to the node leader.\n- **CUDA**: all cubic work runs in hand-written kernels (tiled FP64 GEMM with in-kernel panel mapping and triangular skipping, a 64x64 shared-memory factor kernel, blocked panel solves, generation, validation). A high-priority stream runs the panel path of step k+1 with two-step lookahead while the bulk update of step k runs on another stream, and uploads use a third.\n- **OpenMP**: host-side gather reorder, validation compare, and reductions. The pool is capped at 16 threads per rank by default because 256-thread pools per rank added tens of milliseconds and starved the launch thread. `OMP_NUM_THREADS` is honored if set.\n\n**Correctness**: validation passes for n from 1 to 24576, for 1 to 8 ranks including odd and oversubscribed counts. Printed sums, min, max, and samples match the original to the shown precision; only the FNV hash differs through floating-point rounding order, which is inherent to any parallel ordering. The not-positive-definite path prints the same message and index as the original and exits with 1. Option handling and output text are unchanged; only rank 0 prints.\n\n**Performance** (decomposition time, this node):\n\n| n | original | 1 rank | 2 ranks | 4 ranks |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1000 | 235 ms | 6 ms | | 7 ms |\n| 8192 | | 328 ms | | 120 ms |\n| 16384 | | 2427 ms | 1266 ms | 677 ms |\n| 24576 | | | | 2150 ms (2.3 TFLOPS) |\n\nA single rank reaches roughly the FP64 peak of an RTX 3090. Four-rank scaling is 3.6x at n=16384.\n\n**Build** (from `cholesky/`):\n\n```\ncmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build\nmpirun -np 4 ./build/cholesky -n 16384 -v\n```\n\nThe CUDA architecture defaults to sm_86 and can be overridden with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`. One assumption worth knowing: the panel solve multiplies by explicit inverses of 64x64 diagonal sub-blocks, which is standard in GPU Cholesky and well within the validation tolerance for this matrix family."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1509,"cache_read_input_tokens":198974,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1509},"output_tokens":782,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ca2a234b-5dac-43c0-9e64-f3761aa0be98","uuid":"6882725c-d63e-449b-abfe-f9d2c6730759","timestamp":"2026-10-31T05:11:36.566Z","request_id":"req_011CgZjtmm5qGbhg6Nd2ghCC"}
